items.title: Model with relation and __str__
items.body:
from django.db import models


class Post(models.Model):
    author = models.ForeignKey("auth.User", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="posts")
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    body = models.TextField(blank=True)
    published = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-created_at"]

    def __str__(self):
        return self.title
items.description: Typical model with Meta options.

items.title: ORM: filtering
items.body:
Post.objects.filter(published=True, title__icontains="django")
Post.objects.exclude(author__username="bob")
Post.objects.get(pk=1)                      # raises DoesNotExist / MultipleObjectsReturned
Post.objects.filter(created_at__year=2024)
Post.objects.filter(id__in=[1, 2, 3])
Post.objects.order_by("-created_at")[:10]
items.description: Common QuerySet lookups.

items.title: ORM: Q and F expressions
items.body:
from django.db.models import Q, F

Post.objects.filter(Q(published=True) | Q(author=request.user))
Post.objects.filter(~Q(title__startswith="Draft"))
Product.objects.update(price=F("price") * 1.1)      # atomic, no race
items.description: OR conditions and field-to-field operations.

items.title: ORM: aggregate and annotate
items.body:
from django.db.models import Count, Avg, Sum

Order.objects.aggregate(total=Sum("amount"), avg=Avg("amount"))
Author.objects.annotate(n_posts=Count("posts")).filter(n_posts__gt=5)
items.description: Totals across rows and per-row counts.

items.title: ORM: create, update, delete
items.body:
p = Post.objects.create(title="Hi", author=user)
obj, created = Post.objects.get_or_create(title="Hi", defaults={"author": user})
obj, created = Post.objects.update_or_create(title="Hi", defaults={"body": "new"})
Post.objects.filter(published=False).update(published=True)
Post.objects.bulk_create([Post(title="a", author=user), Post(title="b", author=user)])
Post.objects.filter(pk=1).delete()
items.description: Writes, including get_or_create and bulk operations.

items.title: ORM: values, exists, count

Post.objects.values("id", "title")
Post.objects.values_list("title", flat=True)
Post.objects.filter(published=True).exists()
Post.objects.count()
Post.objects.filter(pk=1).first()
items.description: Lightweight reads.

items.title: URLs
items.body:
# config/urls.py
from django.contrib import admin
from django.urls import include, path

urlpatterns = [
    path("admin/", admin.site.urls),
    path("blog/", include("blog.urls")),
]

# blog/urls.py
from django.urls import path
from . import views

app_name = "blog"
urlpatterns = [
    path("", views.post_list, name="list"),
    path("<int:pk>/", views.post_detail, name="detail"),
]
items.description: Project and app routing.
